verdict.rationale: A game engine editor could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows Godot ships one. The available items are developer building blocks (editor plugins, EditorScript, the built-in GDScript LSP) and third-party community MCP servers hosted outside Godot's own distribution, none of which count as a built-in assistant. Probes also confirm there is no official MCP.
